_comment: Single source of UI strings. tools/gen_i18n.py writes web/i18n.js and unity/Assets/DoodLive/Scripts/L10n.cs. {e} = runtime value.

tagline.zh: 给天使涂上颜色，用手机一扫——她会活过来
tagline.en: Colour the angel, scan it with your phone — and she comes to life

battle.zh: ⚔️ 大卫 vs 歌利亚（战斗剧场）

camFail.zh: 打不开相机：{e}。可以先看演示

noPerm.zh: 需要相机才能看到你的画。在系统设置里允许相机后再试，或先看演示
noPerm.en: The camera is needed to see your drawing. Allow it in Settings and try again, or watch the demo

noAR.zh: 这台设备暂不支持空间定位，先用纸上模式
noAR.en: This device cannot track the room yet; using on-the-page mode

fit.zh: 把整张涂色纸放进框里，四个黑方块对准四个角
fit.en: Fit the whole sheet in the frame, the four black squares in the corners

tap.zh: 点一下天使，听她吹响号角
tap.en: Tap the angel to hear her trumpet

tapXR.zh: 点天使听号角 · 点“放到桌上”让她站进真实空间
tapXR.en: Tap her for the trumpet · "Place on the table" puts her in your room

xrFind.zh: 慢慢移动手机找到桌面或地面，出现金色光圈后点一下屏幕
xrFind.en: Move the phone slowly over a table or floor; tap when the gold ring appears

xrNoPlane.zh: 还没找到平面，先慢慢移动手机，等金色光圈出现再点
xrNoPlane.en: No surface yet — move the phone slowly until the gold ring appears

xrPlaced.zh: 点天使听号角 · 点别处的地面可以挪动她
xrPlaced.en: Tap her for the trumpet · tap elsewhere on the floor to move her

xrExit.zh: 已退出 AR · 点“再来一张”可以再拍一张
xrExit.en: Left AR · "Another sheet" to take another shot

needMarkers.zh: 先让四个黑方块进入画面
needMarkers.en: Get the four black squares into view first

notrack.zh: AR 还没开始追踪：对着明亮、有花纹的桌面或地面，左右慢慢平移手机
notrack.en: AR is not tracking yet: aim at a bright, textured table or floor and pan slowly

nosurface.zh: 在找平面…对准桌面或地面，稍微移动一下
nosurface.en: Looking for a surface… aim at the table or floor and move a little

ok.zh: 找到了！点一下屏幕，把天使放在金色光圈上
ok.en: Found one! Tap the screen to place the angel on the gold ring

lost.zh: 把纸拿回画面里，她就回来
lost.en: Bring the sheet back into view and she returns

help1.zh: 把手机抬高一点，让整张纸都在画面里
help1.en: Lift the phone so the whole sheet is in view

help2.zh: 对着亮一点的地方，别背光
help2.en: Face the light, not away from it

help3.zh: 四个黑方块都要看得见，不要被手挡住
help3.en: All four black squares must be visible — mind your fingers

hello.zh: 哇！我活过来啦！谢谢你给我涂上这么漂亮的颜色！
hello.en: Wow! I'm alive! Thank you for colouring me so beautifully!

line0.zh: 听！天堂的号角为你吹响！
line0.en: Listen! The trumpet of heaven sounds for you!

line1.zh: 你画得真好看，我好喜欢这些颜色！
line1.en: Your drawing is lovely, I adore these colours!

line2.en: May your day be safe and happy!

line3.zh: 再给我画一件新衣服吧！
line3.en: Draw me a new dress next time!
